scope: A development-only follow-up prompted by a corroborated training-fold diagnosis and a failed existing-expert switch. Freeze this formula before the first intervention prediction. The three earlier external scores already exist and are not inputs to this experiment.
trigger: Scan the local-arm records. Require an image task, a corroborated observable lower-tail contrast check and a captured incumbent on each relevant disjoint fold. All other tasks abstain.
candidate: A single inference-time alternative. Only for nonconstant images at or below the registered contrast cutoff, linearly scale around that image's own mean to the median contrast of the primary fitting images. Clip to the primary fitting pixel range and round back to integral pixels when applicable. All other images stay byte-identical. No source identity, architecture, labels, tuning grid or fitted parameters chosen by a human.
adoption: Compare the exact same already-fitted incumbent models before/after. Require a strictly positive full primary-metric gain on both the original primary and first disjoint confirmation folds, mean gain >= 0.003, and positive net rescues within the diagnosed group in confirmation. If either fails retain the incumbent. Where a third existing disjoint fold is available, require nonnegative third-fold gain before any external evaluation.
next_panel: Only if all required internal evidence passes, select 300 uniformly shuffled unique Fashion train records disjoint from all 1200 prior rows, using seed 102711 before external inference. Apply the already-frozen rule to final model predictions and report both scores irrespective of outcome. Do not use course validation or official publisher test sets.
cost: No API, no classifier fit, no tuning retries.
